title: prepare_cached with dynamic IN-clause pollutes statement cache unboundedly
description: list_by_chat builds a dynamic SQL string like 'WHERE message_id IN (?, ?, ?)' with one placeholder per message, then passes it to prepare_cached. The cache key is the full SQL string, so each distinct message count produces a new cached statement that is never evicted. A long-running daemon serving conversations of varying lengths accumulates O(distinct_counts) cache entries, growing without bound. The IN-clause should be replaced with a temporary table or the batch should use a single unnested query.
